::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/transfer_configurations"}
#docs
A run with test twins is one item; its twin job is in `twin`. `scope=business` (the default) lists the runs that copied from or into this business; `scope=organization` lists every run in the organization.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | `string` | no | Whose runs to list. Default `business`. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of runs to return. Default 20. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous `next_cursor`. |
| `offset` | `string` | no | The same as `starting_after`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The runs on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `transfer_configuration`. One of `transfer_configuration`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The job id. |
| `data.status` | `string` | The job status. One of `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`. |
| `data.source_business` | `string` | The source business (biz_…). |
| `data.destination_business` | `string` | The destination business (biz_…). |
| `data.sections` | `array of string` | The sections copied. |
| `data.wipe_destination` | `boolean` | True when the destination was cleared first. |
| `data.options` | `object` | The `numbering` and `include_test_twins` the run was asked for. |
| `data.live_override` | `boolean` | True when the run used the live override. |
| `data.twin_of` | `string` | On a test-twin job: the id of the live job it ran with. |
| `data.report` | `object` | Per section: created, updated and skipped counts. |
| `data.error` | `string` | Why the job failed. |
| `data.twin` | `object` | The test-twin job that ran with this one, in the same shape. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the job started. |
| `data.updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the job last changed. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | True when there are more runs after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` for the next page. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A page of transfer jobs |
| `400` | Invalid query |
| `403` | Requires the admin permission |
